title: 第6583章 双体黑莲第6582章 正所谓虎毒不食子
slug: 吞噬古帝第6589章炼化雷城
lines: 双体黑莲，顶级至宝，需要双保胎同时融合才有效果，对于正常的武者来说根本无用。
苏辰显得很是惊喜。
这次是真正的大惊喜。
在苏辰看来。
其他也许用不上双体黑莲，但自己的两个孩子肯定能够用得上。
两个孩子的防御极其霸道，要是能够融合双体黑莲，相信对于两个孩子来说，绝对是天大的好事情。
似乎能够看出苏辰心中所想，戎汐立刻说道：“辰苏，我听说过双体黑莲，虽然的确是顶级至宝，但需要双保胎能够顺利融合，而你就算是能够拍下，也无法做到融合。”
苏辰点点头，他当然知道戎汐是好心提醒。
只是他不愿意说出，宇宙山内有着自己的两个孩子，并且也是双胞胎。
砰！
听到敲门声，苏辰则是打开门。
看着站在门外的女子，苏辰好奇地问道：“有事？”
可要知道，拍卖行有着属于自己的规则。
无论何时，都不能随意泄露委托者和拍卖者的信息，尤其是包厢内的人。
“你好，我是拍卖会的管事，我找你有点事。”
“请进。”
等到女子进来后，继续说道：“双体黑莲的委托者，让我来问问你，是否愿意拿出你刚刚的所有丹药，各两枚。”
八枚天尊丹外加两枚大帝丹，一共十枚丹药，不得不承认，这个所谓的委托者还真是狮子大开口。
根据苏辰的猜测，这位委托者本身肯定只是天尊境，不是大帝境，要不然的话，怎么可能开口要天尊丹。
想到这里的苏辰，他肯定是想要得到双体黑莲，说道：“帮我转告这位委托者，我只能拿出八枚天尊丹，至于两枚大帝丹，我手里没有，看看他是否愿意。”
不愿意拿出大帝丹，不是没有，而是不愿意，因为他不想给自己招惹麻烦。
“明白。”
“我想问问，拍卖会会泄露我的信息给委托者吗？”
“我明白你的意思，当我可以向你保证，拍卖会不会泄露任何人的信息。”
关上门。
戎汐唏嘘道：“你炼制出的天尊丹和大帝丹，影响实在太大了。”
苏辰只是笑笑，虽然拍卖还在继续，只要委托者不接受的话，哪怕是拍卖会都没有办法强行成交。
不一会。
管事重新进入包厢，说道：“委托者愿意接受，这是双体黑莲。”
强忍着心中的无尽惊喜，苏辰则是直接拿出八枚天尊丹，对于他来说，丹药是最值钱的东西，根本无法和双体黑莲相提并论。
拍卖会结束。
苏辰的元神已经进入宇宙山之中。
两个孩子还在沉睡之中。
不过没有关系，苏辰体内开始运转混沌吞噬诀，头顶上空凝聚出吞噬血轮，包裹住双体黑莲。

;;
Twin Black Lotus, a top-notch treasure, requires both twins to be fused at the same time to be effective, and is completely useless to normal warriors.
Su Chen looked very surprised.
This time it was a real big surprise.
In Su Chen's view.
Others may not be able to use the Double Black Lotus, but their two children will definitely be able to use it.
The defense of the two children is extremely domineering. If they can fuse the two black lotuses, I believe it will be a great thing for the two children.
As if he could see what Su Chen was thinking, Rong tide immediately said: "Chen Su, I have heard of the double black lotus. Although it is indeed a top-notch treasure, it requires double protection to fuse smoothly, and even if you can take a picture, you cannot achieve the fusion."
Su Chen nodded, of course he knew that Rong tide was kindly reminding him.
It's just that he doesn't want to say that there are two children of his own in Universe Mountain, and they are also twins.
Bang!
Hearing the knock on the door, Su Chen opened the door.
Looking at the woman standing outside the door, Su Chen asked curiously: "Is something wrong?"
But you must know that the auction house has its own rules.
At any time, the information of the consignor and auctioneer cannot be disclosed at will, especially the people in the box.
"Hello, I am the manager of the auction, and I have something to ask you."
"Please come in."
After the woman came in, she continued: "The client of the Twin Black Lotus, let me ask you if you are willing to take out all the elixirs you just had, two of each."
Eight Tianzun Pills plus two Great Emperor Pills, a total of ten pills. I have to admit that this so-called client is really a lion.
According to Su Chen's guess, the client must be at the Tianzun level, not the Great Emperor level. Otherwise, how could he ask for the Tianzun Pill?
Thinking of this, Su Chen must have wanted to get the Double Black Lotus, and said: "Tell this client that I can only take out eight Tianzun Pills. As for the two Great Emperor Pills, I don't have them in my hand. Let's see if he is willing."
The unwillingness to take out the Great Emperor Pill was not because he didn't have it, but because he didn't want to cause trouble for himself.
"Understood."
"I would like to ask, will the auction leak my information to the consignor?"
"I understand what you mean, and I can assure you that no one's information will be revealed at the auction."
"Okay."
Close the door.
Rong tide lamented: "The impact of the Tianzun Pill and the Great Emperor Pill you refined is really too great."
Su Chen just smiled. Although the auction was still going on, as long as the consignor did not accept it, even the auction would not be able to force the transaction.
Not a moment.
The steward re-entered the box and said: "The client is willing to accept it. This is a double black lotus."
Holding back the endless surprise in his heart, Su Chen directly took out eight Tianzun Pills. For him, pills were the most valuable thing and could not be compared with the Double Black Lotus.
Auction ends.
Su Chen's soul has entered the Universe Mountain.
The two children were still sleeping.
But it doesn't matter, Su Chen's body began to run the Chaos Devouring Technique, and the Devouring Blood Wheel condensed above his head, wrapping the two black lotus bodies.
